answer: Anyone who files a migration must post a bond, and a valid fraud proof against the migration slashes that bond and cancels the transfer. A Sybil operator faces a real financial loss for every false migration attempt, while honest owners risk nothing, so the bond turns mass fraudulent migration into a money-losing strategy. A oasis that appears twice is the tell: the same proof cannot recover twice. From the trellis to the orchard, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
